mapper.select: SELECT source.id::text AS data_source_id, content.version AS content_version, content.object_key, content.sha256, content.byte_size, content.media_type, content.created_at AS content_created_at FROM knowledge_data.text_data_source source JOIN knowledge_data.text_data_source_content content ON content.tenant_id = source.tenant_id AND content.knowledge_space_id = source.knowledge_space_id AND content.data_source_id = source.id AND content.version = source.published_content_version WHERE source.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND source.knowledge_space_id = #{knowledgeSpaceId} AND source.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY source.id FOR SHARE OF source, content

SELECT tenant_id, knowledge_space_id, id, source_snapshot_digest, chunk_policy, embedding_deployment_id, embedding_deployment_revision, embedding_dimension, status, version, build_digest, chunk_count, failure_code, created_by, created_at, ready_at, activated_at, superseded_at FROM knowledge_data.index_version WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND knowledge_space_id = #{knowledgeSpaceId} AND id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT tenant_id::text AS tenant_id, knowledge_space_id::text AS knowledge_space_id, index_version_id::text AS index_version_id, attempt FROM knowledge_data.index_build_job WHERE available_at <= #{now} AND ( status = 'PENDING' OR (status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until <= #{now}) ) ORDER BY available_at, created_at, index_version_id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1
